profile.research_note: [batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This is the Genome Data Center, a computing facility supporting the McDonnell Genome Institute, formerly the Genome Sequencing Center, at Washington University in St. Louis School of Medicine. The university own facilities management department publishes a dedicated page for the Genome Data Center, confirming it as real, currently documented infrastructure. The McDonnell Genome Institute is one of the best known genomics research centers in the United States, having played a major role in the Human Genome Project and continuing large scale DNA sequencing for cancer research, infectious disease, and other genomics work, requiring substantial data storage and computing capacity. This is a research computing facility serving the university genomics programs rather than a general purpose enterprise or commercial data center, and no specific critical IT megawattage figure was found published. This research was carried out at the operator level in an earlier phase of this project.
